notes: The registered C row requires POS_SLEEPING and LVL_GRGOD; the focused registry test pins both gates under R1/R2/R5e.
No target prints C's syntax and raw-index four-column spells list, including mixed line endings, under R1/R3/R5e.
Visible-world miss returns C NOPERSON before parsing the remaining arguments under R1/R3/R5e.
A visible target with no remaining argument reaches the exact mixed-order C error under R1/R5e.
A non-quote first byte reaches C's enclosure refusal before skill lookup under R1/R5e.
An opening quote without a closing quote reaches the exact enclosure refusal under R1/R5e.
C lowercases the quoted input and rejects an unresolved find_skill_num result under R1/R3/R5e.
A recognized quoted skill with no one_argument value reaches the exact learned-value error under R1/R5e.
A negative atoi result reaches the minimum learned-value refusal under R1/R3/R5e.
A learned value above 100 reaches the maximum refusal before NPC/state mutation under R1/R3/R5e.
A visible ordinal mob target reaches the NPC rejection only after skill/value gates under R1/R3/R5e.
A valid player mutation stores the resolved skill value and emits C's confirmation bytes under R1/R3/R5e.
Quoted multiword input follows C token-prefix skill lookup and confirms the canonical spells[] display name under R1/R3/R5e.
The C get_char_room_vis self/me aliases select the actor and mutate that player under R1/R3/R5e.
In-room player keyword abbreviation reaches the same C target before the skill parser under R1/R2/R5e.
The 0.<name> player-only lookup is preserved before mutation under R1/R2/R5e.
The first numeric prefix of the one_argument token controls the stored value, matching C atoi under R1/R3/R5e.
Trailing value words are not parsed after C one_argument; only the first token reaches atoi under R1/R2/R3/R5e.
